_note: Copy to tools/mapping.json (git-ignored) and edit. Left side = INTERNAL names, right side = PUBLIC ids from data/services.json. Only mapped items are ever published (allowlist), so unmapped internal jobs/guests can never leak. Internal names never appear in the output.

prometheus._note: label = which label on 'up{...}' identifies the target (usually 'job' or 'instance'). 'rules' match any set of labels (exact match; '__name__' = metric name), e.g. prometheus-pve-exporter's pve_up{id="qemu/107"} or {id="lxc/101"}. Rules win over 'map'. For pve_up, 1 = guest running, 0 = guest not running (reported as off_state, default 'down'). Run with PROM_QUERY='pve_up or up'. Several internal names / rules may map to the same public id.
prometheus.label: job

proxmox._note: Proxmox guest IDs (vmid) -> public ids. Only used when PVE_URL is set. A guest that is 'stopped' is reported as 'stopped' (not 'down').
